messages:
Anya: Hey team — quick sync on the webinar launch + social plan. We need X+LinkedIn schedule, 3 headline variants for the benchmark narrative, and a clear inbound lead routing map. Can we lock this today?
Mike: I can take the scheduling. Do we want a single cadence for both X and LinkedIn or staggered posts?
Anya: Staggered. X gets the initial teaser + live thread, LinkedIn gets the longer form recap + CTA the next day. Keep timing: X morning PT, LinkedIn lunchtime PT.
Jess: Working on headline variants now. Quick question — should benchmark narrative lean technical (latency/cost) or product (what customers build)?
Anya: Product-first, but include a 1-line stat on latency improvements. Example: “Ship LLM features 3x cheaper with predictable latency.”
Sam: For inbound routing: prefer SDR queue A for webinar signups from sponsored posts, organic leads to the nurture flow. Add UTM params for source=linkedin/x, campaign=webinar_may.
Ryan: Adding tracking: can we standardize utm_content to be variant id (v1/v2/v3)? Makes QA easier.
Jess: Good call — will do v1/v2/v3 in the copy doc. Also need image assets — hero slide + 4 social cards. Who owns final images?
Anya: Design owns hero & cards; @Mike can you file the asset request with priority: high?
Mike: Filing now. ETA from design ~24-36h. I’ll attach the brief in #design-requests.
social-bot: Deploy scheduled post created: channel=X, time=2024-06-12T15:00:00Z, draft_id=dl_8741
Sam: For engagement follow-ups: recommend a pinned comment on X with sign-up link + 2 follow-up replies from our account at +30m and +4h. For LinkedIn, comment from execs + CTA in first comment.
Anya: Love it. Also we need 2 short testimonial blurbs (50–70 chars) for replies — Jess, can you draft?
Jess: Yep — will drop 3 micro-testimonials in the copy doc by EOD.
Mike: Scheduling summary: teaser X (6/12 AM PT), live thread X (6/12 midday PT), LinkedIn long form (6/13 noon PT). I’ll post the calendar grid in the doc.
Ryan: Routing note: send all signups to HubSpot form id=4598, webhook to /lead-bridge/webinar. SDR owners mapped in the sheet.
Sam: I’ll add a quick Zapier check to ensure lead owner assignment respects timezone.
Anya: Perfect. Last thing — benchmark narrative should have an excerpt for social (one-liner stat + CTA). Jess, include that as "social_blurb" in the doc.
Jess: Noted. Uploading copy + variants to the shared doc now: https://docs.google.com/… (edited)
Mike: Once design uploads assets, I’ll create the scheduling queue and tag ops for final approval.
Anya: Thanks all. If nothing blocks, we’ll ship the teaser tomorrow. :rocket:
